title: Distillation of Discrete Diffusion through Dimensional Correlations
tldr_zh: 用混合模型显式学维度相关性，把多步独立分解的教师蒸馏成 few-step 学生，并给出学生-教师分布距离上界
tldr_en: Mixture models capture dimensional correlations to distill multi-step product teachers into few-step students, with TV distance upper bounds
